newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint ends steady vs dollar in slack trade.
newsitem.headline: Forint ends steady vs dollar in slack trade.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed little changed against the dollar on Friday in quiet trade, dealers said.
The forint ended right on the national bank resistance level (bid) at 155.50/55 to the dollar, little changed from its 155.52/57 opening, traders said.
"The Hungarian unit tracked the dollar/mark cross on international markets," said Istvan Hideg of Takarekbank. "Turnover was very low."
Turnover on the futures market of the Budapest Commodity Exchange was above average at 3.66 billion forints. Most trade was shared between the dollar and sterling.
The dollar rose for December and March and fell for June while the pound registered a steep rise of 7.4 forints for June.
